# Built-in plugins

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-plugins.mjs. Edit catalog.json, not this file. -->

Plugins that ship with Discordia, disabled until enabled in Settings > Discordia > Plugin Library.
Each is built from the vendored source in `sources/`, pinned to the upstream commit in `catalog.json`,
and remains under its author's license (the upstream `LICENSE` is kept next to each source tree).
Thanks to all of the authors below.

Selection: plugins marked working (or working with a known issue) in the community list at
https://github.com/Purple-EyeZ/Plugins-List whose repositories carry a license, plus licensed Enmity plugins.

## Built into Discordia

Rewritten for the current Discord as part of Discordia (always available, disabled until enabled), combining the plugins below.

- `discordia:message-logger`: `vendetta:angelix1/antied`, `vendetta:angelix1/antiedzero`, `vendetta:redstonekasi/message-logger`, `vendetta:meqativ/nodelete`, `enmity:m4fn3/trackedit`
- `discordia:platform-indicators`: `vendetta:martinz64/platformindicators`, `enmity:m4fn3/betterstatusindicator`
- `discordia:radial-status`: `vendetta:angelix1/radialstatus`
- `discordia:hide-chat-buttons`: `enmity:serstars/hidechatbuttons`, `vendetta:janisslsm/hidecallbuttons`

## Merged or removed

Duplicates and plugins for features Discord has since removed. Merged plugins' features live on in the plugin they point to.

- `enmity:colin273/freemoji` → `vendetta:rico040/freemoji`: Same feature; the Vendetta version adds hyperlink and size options.
- `enmity:ssense1337/dashless` → `vendetta:awesomegamergame/dashless`: Identical feature.
- `enmity:aeongdesu/viewraw` → `vendetta:bwlok/viewraw`: Identical feature.
- `enmity:stupiditydb/enmityplugin` → `vendetta:janisslsm/reviewdb`: Older ReviewDB client.
- `enmity:byeoon/actionsheetfinder` → `vendetta:rico040/action-sheet-finder`: Identical feature.
- `enmity:acquitelol/dislate` → `vendetta:rico040/dislate`: Dislate Lite has the same translators plus immersive (original + translation) mode.
- `enmity:m4fn3/fakesticker` → `vendetta:aliernfrog/freestickers`: FreeStickers adds APNG conversion, hyperlink and size options.
- `enmity:debianprogrammer/fakestickerfixed` → `vendetta:aliernfrog/freestickers`: Same as FakeSticker.
- `enmity:m4fn3/fixconnecting`: Worked around a Discord connection bug that no longer exists.
- `enmity:debianprogrammer/fixconnectingfixed`: Same as FixConnecting.
- `enmity:doggybootsy/silent-typing` → `vendetta:redstonekasi/no-typing`: Identical feature.
- `enmity:colin273/noreplymention` → `vendetta:amsryq/noautoreplymention`: NoAutoReplyMention adds per-user exemptions and a blacklist mode.
- `vendetta:vaiskiainen/removebanner` → `vendetta:otkusteyler/revokeuserbanner`: RemoveUserBanner adds friend/self exemptions and custom-banner handling.
- `enmity:ssense1337/hidegiftbutton` → `enmity:serstars/hidechatbuttons`: HideChatButtons has a gift button toggle plus voice, thread and app launcher.
- `enmity:ssense1337/accountswitcher` → `vendetta:apexteampl/morealts`: More Alts adds account management and unlocks the native switcher.
- `vendetta:kmmiio99o/last.fm` → `vendetta:kmmiio99o/multi-scrobbler`: Multi Scrobbler (same author) supports Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Libre.fm.
- `vendetta:purple-eyez/plugins-list`: Shows the same community list as Discordia's Plugin Library.
- `enmity:m4fn3/freenitrotheme` → `vendetta:aeongdesu/clientthemes`: ClientThemes is a port of this plugin.
- `enmity:debianprogrammer/confirmcalls` → `vendetta:amsryq/moreconfirm`: MoreConfirm confirms calls (and more).
- `vendetta:angelix1/antied` → `discordia:message-logger`: Merged into Discordia's Message Logger (custom colors, ignore lists, edit history).
- `vendetta:angelix1/antiedzero` → `discordia:message-logger`: Merged into Discordia's Message Logger.
- `vendetta:redstonekasi/message-logger` → `discordia:message-logger`: Merged into Discordia's Message Logger (PluralKit filtering, row highlighting).
- `vendetta:meqativ/nodelete` → `discordia:message-logger`: Merged into Discordia's Message Logger (deletion timestamps, ignore lists).
- `enmity:m4fn3/trackedit` → `discordia:message-logger`: Merged into Discordia's Message Logger (colored edit history).
- `vendetta:martinz64/platformindicators` → `discordia:platform-indicators`: Rebuilt as a Discordia plugin: the original identified components by names Discord now minifies. Same surfaces, plus live updates.
- `enmity:m4fn3/betterstatusindicator` → `discordia:platform-indicators`: Per-status custom colors merged into Discordia's Platform Indicators.
- `vendetta:angelix1/radialstatus` → `discordia:radial-status`: Rebuilt on Discord's shared Avatar component; the original matched avatars by exact pixel sizes that changed.
- `enmity:serstars/hidemessageshortcuts`: Discord removed the message shortcut feature this plugin hid (none of its shortcut functions exist in 348).
- `enmity:acquitelol/enmity-utility-patches`: Patched Enmity-era UI (BadgableTabBar, media grid sizing) that no longer exists.
- `enmity:acquitelol/enmity-you`: Added Enmity's own settings to the You tab; Discordia has its own settings section.
- `enmity:ssense1337/filepicker`: Enabled an experimental file picker; current Discord attaches files natively.
- `enmity:acquitelol/enmity-pronoun-db`: Discord now shows pronouns natively, and the profile components it patched were replaced.
- `enmity:serstars/hidechatbuttons` → `discordia:hide-chat-buttons`: Rebuilt as a Discordia plugin for the current chat input (the class it patched was removed).
- `enmity:hauntii/splasher` → `vendetta:rico040/userbg`: Relied on a banner prop current Discord no longer uses; UserBG provides custom banners.
- `enmity:ssense1337/showallactivities`: Current Discord profiles have an Activity tab listing every activity; the component this patched now chooses its activity internally.
- `vendetta:janisslsm/hidecallbuttons` → `discordia:hide-chat-buttons`: Merged into Hide Chat Buttons: Discord now renders call buttons with icon components, so they are matched by PhoneCallIcon/VideoIcon.

## Excluded

- `enmity:m4fn3/k2gelocker`: Requires the K2genmity native tweak for biometric auth.
- `enmity:m4fn3/addonmanager`: An Enmity addon manager; overlaps with Discordia's own plugin manager.

## Updating

```sh
python3 scripts/sync-plugins.py --update   # move pins to each repository's latest commit and re-vendor
pnpm build:plugins
```
